newsitem.title: PERU: Peru bus overturns, kills and injuries dozens.
newsitem.headline: Peru bus overturns, kills and injuries dozens.

text.p: A bus overturned on Friday killing a number of passengers and injuring dozens more as it travelled between the popular tourist towns of Cusco and Nasca, police said.

Police said 23 people, including at least one infant, were killed. But a representative of the bus company Ciba, who asked to remain anonymous, told Reuters the death toll of the accident -- about 500 miles (800 km) southeast of Lima -- was no higher than 10.
Local radio station CPN also reported 23 deaths saying at least five bodies had arrived at a local hospital morgue.
The cause of the accident was not known.
The crash occurred in the high-altitude flat plains of the Pampa Galeras region in the department of Ayucucho at a spot known as Toro Muerto, or Dead Bull, the police said.

The frequency of road accidents in the Peruvian Andes, where most people travel along poorly maintained highways on buses that are often overloaded, has led pressure groups to call for an overhaul of the country's transport regulations.
